parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against target CHEMBL1785. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
